scope: Explicit connected equal-positive-weight binary two-block cyclic CSS inputs. Full gcd F=1 returns NoLogical; F!=1 and orbit span <= min(N-1,floor(log2(N+1))) returns exact physical distance and minimum original-coordinate nonboundary witness; other surviving inputs return Unrecognized. Even orders and full multiplicities retained.
resources: Conservative deterministic sequential bit time O((N+1)^12), storage O((N+1)^4), including discovery and rejection. Polynomial is theoretical, not an executed performance claim.
